### Added

- *(agent-platform)* Start every session through start_session in [#2918](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2918) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* Explain an empty or incomplete agents list on Customize in [#2948](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2948) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster)* Open a connector's Tools tab on the Connectors search in [#2949](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2949) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(app)* Show the full Giant Swarm logo on the Agent Platform sign-in page in [#2954](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2954) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Scope the Model hosting pages to one environment in [#2951](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2951) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster)* Offer Edit in Git for GitOps-managed workflows in [#2950](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2950) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Add a Show tool activity switch to the session page in [#2953](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2953) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Say where the Usage data starts when the range reaches back further in [#2956](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2956) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster)* Details tab with technical details on the connector page in [#2952](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2952) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Move the skill page's facts into its Overview and share the connector page's Used by list in [#2968](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2968) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster)* Split the workflow page into Overview, Usage and Details tabs in [#2960](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2960) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Workspaces tab lists an Organization's workspaces in [#2961](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2961) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(muster)* Give every connector tool a page of its own and list the tools as links in [#2966](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2966) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Explain a missing kagent on Home the way Customize › Agents does in [#2964](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2964) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update dependency fast-xml-parser to v5.11.2 in [#2945](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2945) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update dependency pg to v8.23.1 in [#2977](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2977) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])

### Fixed

- *(agent-platform)* Show the Usage token breakdown, align the time range in [#2946](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2946) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Answer a still-running resumed turn 202 on the streaming answer route instead of a 500 in [#2947](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2947) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Give select options in the agent shell more room in [#2965](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2965) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster-backend)* Refuse agent-manager calls under muster's shared identity in [#2963](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2963) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* Retry a session delete while its last turn settles in [#2970](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2970) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(ui-react)* Keep shell page header actions beside the title and aligned with the Environment select in [#2967](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2967) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Withhold agent-manager actions where muster has no per-user sign-in in [#2972](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2972) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
